meta.title: How Clothes Shape Our Behavior and Self-Perception

paragraphs.text: We all take a little extra effort to look nice for special occasions. But most of us have conflicting feelings about dressing up and feel guilty about taking the time to focus on clothes. Science now suggests the right dress may give ourselves the extra edge in our professional and personal lives.

sentences.text: Science now suggests the right dress may give ourselves the extra edge in our professional and personal lives.

paragraphs.text: We hear sayings like "dress for the job you want; not the job you have". Most people don't really believe in them, but research into the impact of clothes on behavior now suggests that there may actually be a grain of truth in these sayings. Science says that the clothes we wear affect our behavior, our mood and even the way we interact with others because of the symbolic meaning that we assign to different types of clothing.

sentences.text: We hear sayings like "dress for the job you want; not the job you have".

analysis.translationLiteral: 我们听到像『为你想要的工作穿衣；而不是为你已有的工作穿衣』这样的说法。
analysis.translationNatural: 『想坐哪个位子，就照那个位子穿』——这类话我们没少听。
analysis.structMarkup: 【We】 _hear_ ~sayings~ (like "dress for the job you want; not the job you have").
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓宾 + 介词短语作同位举例（含分号并列的祈使结构）

components.note: 泛指人们，用第一人称拉近距离
及物动词，后接名词宾语 sayings
复数名词指流行格言，后面 like 引出具体一例

components.part: like "dress for the job you want; not the job you have"
components.note: like 作介词举例；引号内两条并列祈使由分号隔开，形成 want 与 have 的对照，卷面句号在引号外须照抄

clauses: 本句是简单句，没有从句；主干为「主谓宾 + 介词短语作同位举例（含分号并列的祈使结构）」。

phrases.meaning: 像（介词）；喜欢（动词）；口语连词「像……那样」
phrases.usage: 注意区分：like（介词，后接名词）/ as（连词，后接从句）。常见搭配：like this / feel like。
phrases.example: Tools like this save time. 这样的工具能省时间。

phrases.meaning: 想要（want to do / want sb to do）；需要
phrases.usage: 注意区分：want to do（想要）/ need to do（需要）/ would like to do（更礼貌）。常见搭配：want to do / want sb to do。
phrases.example: They want to appear more adult. 他们想显得更成熟。

pitfalls: 注意区分：like（介词，后接名词）/ as（连词，后接从句）。
注意区分：want to do（想要）/ need to do（需要）/ would like to do（更礼貌）。
analysis.paragraphRole: 先摆一句耳熟能详的俗话，作为下句『多数人不信、研究却说有点道理』的引子。

sentences.text: Most people don't really believe in them, but research into the impact of clothes on behavior now suggests that there may actually be a grain of truth in these sayings.

analysis.translationLiteral: 大多数人并不真的相信它们，但是对着装对行为的影响的研究现在提示：在这些说法中可能确实有一粒真理。
analysis.translationNatural: 多数人只当耳旁风，可研究衣着如何影响行为的结果反倒说：这些老话还真有点道理。
analysis.structMarkup: Most people don't really believe in them, but 【research into the impact of clothes on behavior】 _now suggests that there may actually be a grain of truth in these sayings_.
analysis.structureSummary: 并列句（but 连接两个分句，后分句含 that 宾语从句与 There be 句型）

components.part: Most people don't really believe in them
components.note: believe in 意为『信奉、当真』，them 回指上句 sayings；really 加强否定
转折，把『不信』与『研究支持』对立起来

components.part: research into the impact of clothes on behavior
components.note: 核心词 research 为单数；into / on 两层介词短语叠用，限定研究的是衣着对行为的影响

components.part: now suggests that there may actually be a grain of truth in these sayings
components.note: that 引导宾语从句；there be 句型里 a grain of truth 是固定说法『一点道理』，may 与 actually 把语气拿捏得留有余地

clauses: that 引导宾语从句，作前面动词的宾语，从句用陈述语序。
本句主干为「并列句（but 连接两个分句，后分句含 that 宾语从句与 There be 句型）」，先找限定动词再切分修饰成分。

phrases.meaning: 人们（复数集合名词，谓语用复数）；民族（可数）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：people（人们，复数）/ person（一个人）/ peoples（多个民族）。常见搭配：young people / people in business。
phrases.example: Most people agree on this point. 多数人同意这一点。

phrases.meaning: 真正地、确实；非常（口语）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：really（真正地）/ real（形容词）/ actually（实际上）。常见搭配：really important / not really。
phrases.example: They do not really reflect everyday behaviour. 它们并没有真正反映日常行为。

phrases.meaning: 相信、认为
phrases.usage: 常见搭配：believe in / believe that。
phrases.example: I believe he is right. 我认为他是对的。

pitfalls: 宾语从句用陈述语序，不要把助动词提到主语前。
注意区分：people（人们，复数）/ person（一个人）/ peoples（多个民族）。
注意区分：really（真正地）/ real（形容词）/ actually（实际上）。
analysis.paragraphRole: 用 but 完成从俗话到实证的过渡，为下一句讲清『为什么衣服能影响人』铺路。

sentences.text: Science says that the clothes we wear affect our behavior, our mood and even the way we interact with others because of the symbolic meaning that we assign to different types of clothing.

analysis.translationLiteral: 科学说：我们穿的衣服影响我们的行为、我们的心情、甚至我们与他人互动的方式，因为那份我们赋予不同种类服装的象征意义。
analysis.translationNatural: 科学的说法是：衣服之所以能左右举止、情绪乃至待人接物的方式，全因我们给不同服装附会了不同的象征意味。
analysis.structMarkup: Science says {that the clothes we wear affect our behavior, our mood and even the way} {we interact with others} (because of the symbolic meaning) {that we assign to different types of clothing}.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓 + 宾语从句（that 引导，含三个并列宾语、省略关系代词的定语从句与 because of 原因状语，状语内又含 that 定语从句）

components.note: 与上段 suggests 同义复现，继续以研究结论的口吻陈述

components.part: that the clothes we wear affect our behavior, our mood and even the way
components.note: 从句主语 the clothes 后接省略关系代词的定语从句 we wear；谓语 affect 带三个并列宾语，even 把 the way 推到最意外的一层
修饰 the way，关系代词 that / in which 被省略，说明『与人打交道的方式』
because of 后接名词短语，点出前三个影响的共同原因——象征意义，正是第 47 题的落点

components.part: that we assign to different types of clothing
components.note: that 修饰 meaning；assign A to B 意为『把 A 赋予 B』

clauses: 宾语从句「that the clothes we wear affect our behavior, our mood and even the wa」：从句主语 the clothes 后接省略关系代词的定语从句 we wear；谓语 affect 带三个并列宾语，even 把 the way 推到最意外的一层
定语从句「we interact with others」：修饰 the way，关系代词 that / in which 被省略，说明『与人打交道的方式』
定语从句「that we assign to different types of clothing」：that 修饰 meaning；assign A to B 意为『把 A 赋予 B』

phrases.meaning: 因为
phrases.usage: 介词短语后接名词；because 才是连词，后接句子。
phrases.example: We stayed in because of the storm. 因为暴风雨我们没出门。

phrases.meaning: 科学；理科
phrases.usage: 注意区分：science（科学，不可数；一门学科，可数）/ scientist（科学家，指人，-ist）/ scientific（科学的，形容词）/ technology（技术、工艺）/ -ence 名词后缀（difference、patience）。常见搭配：funding for science / science proceeds。
phrases.example: Science says that the clothes we wear affect our behavior, our mood and even the way we interact with others because of the symbolic meaning that we assign to different types of clothing. 科学的说法是：衣服之所以能左右举止、情绪乃至待人接物的方式，全因我们给不同服装附会了不同的象征意味。

phrases.meaning: say 的第三人称单数（说）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：says /sez/ 发音不按规则；注意与 say 的过去式 said /sed/ 区分。常见搭配：she says that / as the report says。

analysis.paragraphRole: 给出全文的机制解释，把『衣服影响人』归因于象征意义，直接支撑第 47、48 题。

paragraphs.text: We consider some clothes to be powerful, some to be fun, and so on. We even evaluate people whom we have just met based on their clothes. We also evaluate ourselves based on what we are wearing because of the way they make us feel. This means that the experience of wearing something affects our attitudes and our choice of behavior.

sentences.text: We consider some clothes to be powerful, some to be fun, and so on.

analysis.translationLiteral: 我们认为一些衣服是强势的，一些是有趣的，等等。
analysis.translationNatural: 我们会觉得有的衣服显气场、有的衣服图个好玩，诸如此类。

phrases.example: We consider some clothes to be powerful, some to be fun, and so on. 我们会觉得有的衣服显气场、有的衣服图个好玩，诸如此类。

sentences.text: We even evaluate people whom we have just met based on their clothes.

components.note: 复数主语，谓语用 have found，以研究口吻给上句判断撑腰

状语从句「when they wear formal clothes」：when 把副作用绑定到『穿正装』这一条件上

phrases.meaning: 研究（study 的复数）；study 的第三人称单数

clauses: 本句是简单句，没有从句；主干为「主谓宾 + 不定式作宾补（不带 to）+ 状语」。

phrases.meaning: 另一方面

phrases.meaning: 帮助（help sb do sth / help with）；帮助（不可数）（help 的复数/三单形式）

phrases.meaning: 变得（系动词）；成为

sentences.text: These findings support the idea of wearing business casuals on a Friday; since colleagues are most likely to take out time to socialize on the last work day of the week.

phrases.meaning: 研究结果、调查发现（finding 的复数）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：findings（研究结果、发现，常用复数名词）/ find（找到，动词）/ finding（单项发现，可数）/ findings 与 conclusion（conclusion 是「结论」，findings 是「发现的事实」）/ research findings。
phrases.example: These findings support the idea of wearing business casuals on a Friday; since colleagues are most likely to take out time to socialize on the last work day of the week. 所以研究反倒给『周五穿商务休闲』撑了腰——一周收尾那天，同事本来就最愿意腾空儿聊聊天。

phrases.meaning: 支持、资助
phrases.usage: 常见搭配：support science / financial support。
phrases.example: These findings support the idea of wearing business casuals on a Friday; since colleagues are most likely to take out time to socialize on the last work day of the week. 所以研究反倒给『周五穿商务休闲』撑了腰——一周收尾那天，同事本来就最愿意腾空儿聊聊天。

phrases.meaning: 想法、主意（可数）；概念

sentences.text: I mean, who wants to hang out with people in their suits?

analysis.translationLiteral: 我是说，谁想和穿着他们西装的人一起消磨时间呢？

analysis.structMarkup: (I mean), 【who】 _wants to hang out with_ ~people in their suits~?

components.note: 口语化补充说明，把前句的建议说得轻松

clauses: 本句为疑问句；一般疑问句把助动词/系动词提前，特殊疑问句用疑问词开头。
本句主干为「插入语 + 修辞性疑问句（主谓宾 + 介词短语作后置定语）」，先找限定动词再切分修饰成分。

phrases.meaning: 意味着、意思是；打算 / 吝啬的、刻薄的
phrases.usage: 注意区分：mean to do（打算做）/ mean doing（意味着）。常见搭配：mean that / mean to do。
phrases.example: This would mean the end of a career. 这就意味着职业生涯的终结。

phrases.meaning: 想要（want to do / want sb to do）；需要（want 的复数/三单形式）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：wants（复数/三单）/ want（原形）。
phrases.example: I mean, who wants to hang out with people in their suits? 想想也是——谁乐意跟一身笔挺西装的人闲混啊？

phrases.meaning: 人们（复数集合名词，谓语用复数）；民族（可数）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：people（人们，复数）/ person（一个人）/ peoples（多个民族）。常见搭配：young people / people in business。
